How to use the map

Read top to bottom: exam scope → domain → task statement → service choices. Click a task for complete study notes. Click a service for its purpose, task mapping and official icon source.

Colored arrows connect the exam structure. Service cards are attached to the task they support.

Exam facts

CLF-C02 has scored and unscored questions, multiple-choice and multiple-response formats, a 100–1,000 scaled score, and a 700 passing score. AWS states that coding, implementation and troubleshooting are outside the target candidate scope.
